meaning: to pause before doing something because you are unsure（犹豫）
example: I hesitated for a moment before I knocked on the door.

meaning: a large cup with a handle, used for coffee or tea（马克杯）
example: She filled her mug with hot coffee and sat by the window.

meaning: a container used for boiling water（烧水壶）
example: Put the kettle on and we will have some tea.

meaning: a thing you hold over your head when it rains（雨伞）
example: Take an umbrella with you because it looks like rain.

meaning: to travel regularly between home and work（通勤）
example: I commute to work by subway every morning.

meaning: food remaining after a meal（剩饭剩菜）
example: We had the leftovers from last night for lunch today.

meaning: a line of people waiting（排队）
example: There was a long queue outside the ticket office.

meaning: the latest time by which something must be done（截止时间）
example: I have to finish this report before the deadline on Friday.

meaning: a person you work with（同事）
example: A colleague of mine gave me a lift home.

meaning: extra hours worked beyond normal hours（加班）
example: I worked overtime three evenings this week.

meaning: the owner who rents a place to you（房东）
example: The landlord raised the rent again this year.

meaning: money paid as a first part or as security（押金/定金）
example: We paid a deposit of two months of rent for the flat.

meaning: a paper proving you paid（收据）
example: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.

meaning: money returned to you（退款）
example: I asked for a full refund because the shoes did not fit.

meaning: an arranged meeting at a fixed time（预约）
example: I made an appointment with the dentist for next Monday.

meaning: extremely tired（精疲力尽）
example: After the long flight I felt completely exhausted.

meaning: slightly angry（有点恼火）
example: I was annoyed with myself for forgetting her birthday.

meaning: feeling thankful（感激）
example: I am really grateful for all your help last week.

meaning: embarrassing or difficult to deal with（尴尬/不好处理）
example: There was an awkward silence after he asked about her old boyfriend.

meaning: to understand or solve something（想明白/弄清楚）
collocations: figure out how to do sth
example: I could not figure out how to open the box at first.
